name: Natsuiro Kokoro Log ~Happy Summer~
original_name: ナツイロココロログ～Happy Summer～
source:
This is the fandisc for Natsuiro Kokoro Log, featuring after stories for each of the four heroines, as well as harem routes for both the real and virtual worlds. It takes place one year after the original game as the computer research club members head to a training camp and end up helping out at a traditional Japanese café.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/03/01/march-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是《Natsuiro Kokoro Log》的粉丝碟，收录四位女主角的后日谈，以及现实世界和虚拟世界的后宫路线。故事发生在本篇一年后，电脑研究部成员前往合宿，最后在一家日式传统咖啡馆帮忙。

（来源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/03/01/march-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]）
